body:
Quick pass (coordinator, read only, no build) on head `b2b596b66`: the PR is a sub-PR of `side/path-kernel` and merges cleanly with it (`df9ec30b6`, merged in). The author's gate is green on this head: `cargo check --tests` and clippy for motion, the unit tests of `kernel_emit` (7), the motion `kernel_laws` suite (31), the quick gate against the side branch (13 steps, the three example catalog suites included) and the light lane (7 steps). The writer record on #4269 is released. The body starts with `Side branch: side/path-kernel` and has `Refs #4269`. The PR is flagged ready. It waits for the independent review.

Notes for the reviewer. The safety floor applies: this code writes the moves that are posted.
- A finding on the side branch: the pin `k3_load::kernel_load_control_round_the_disc_and_the_dog_bone` is red on the side head `df9ec30b6`. PR #4265 was gated without PR #4253, and the two together change one row (the disc, Outside, constant engagement: 337 and 77, not 334 and 74). This PR pins that row again as measured. Check that the new values are the measured ones.
- PR #4275 (the approach from the air) is open at the same time. It changes the same Outside rows of `k3_load.rs` and makes the Outside lift counts of the K4 pin 0. This PR keeps 13 and 15. The PR that merges second takes a merge of the side branch and pins the rows again.
- The verifier pin uses the stock grown by four tool radii, less the part, as its area. With two tool radii the verifier reported gouges on the air entries and their arc leads, far from the part. Check that the wider area does not hide a real gouge.
- Check the rules of the converter: a rapid only at the clearance height, a refusal for each step that it cannot emit, nothing dropped and no cut added.

The head review above stands: the code on `b2b596b` is clean (7/7 kernel_emit, 31/31 kernel_laws, clippy green, light lane 7/7 with 0 failed). The base moved under the PR since: #4275 (the approach from the air, `fd653b035`) merged into `side/path-kernel` and changes the same two files — the Outside rows of `k3_load.rs` (`[415, 145, 19]` / `[344, 122, 81]` on the disc, `[739, 180, 13]` / `[683, 143, 69]` on the dog bone) and the Outside lift counts of the K4 pin (0, not 13/15). A trial merge now reports CONFLICTING in `crates/motion/tests/kernel_laws/k3_load.rs` and `crates/motion/tests/kernel_laws/k4_order_link.rs`.

This is the orange case, not the green one. The author refreshes the branch with a merge of `side/path-kernel`, keeps the converter's own k4/k3_load assertions, re-pins the rows as measured, pushes, and flags ready for a fresh review. Not merge-ready.

Merge-time refresh. New head: `143a6ffafba794b4575b2c263ea919b2b92a0d02` (the merge of `origin/side/path-kernel` fd653b0 into the branch, plain push). Class: DELTA (the conflicts are resolved by hand). The new head waits for a fresh review.

Conflicted files and the resolution:
- `crates/motion/tests/kernel_laws/k3_load.rs`: the `READ` row of disc Outside. The rows of #4275 are kept. They measure the same on the merged tree with `cuts_path_with` of this PR. The row 337 / 77 of this PR is replaced. The doc comment of #4275 is kept, with one line that names the 337 / 77 row.
- `crates/motion/tests/kernel_laws/k4_order_link.rs`: the module doc. The text of both sides is kept. The lift table of #4275 (0 on each case) merged without a conflict and holds with the real converter.

Added in the merge commit:
- `kernel_path_with` also asserts the converter's counts of entries, stay-down links and exits against the plan (the counts of cuts and lifts were asserted before).
- The K4 assertion "no feed crosses another" is now the measured table `CROSSINGS`. See the finding below.
- `docs/decisions/4269-kernel-plan-converter.md`: the section "The merge of #4254".

Rows (feed moves above the limit, the worst engagement, the unnamed moves):

| Pin | Case | Before (b2b596b) | #4275 | After (143a6ff) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| k3_load, no control | disc Outside | [402, 145, 13] | [415, 145, 19] | [415, 145, 19] |
| k3_load, constant | disc Outside | [337, 118, 77] | [344, 122, 81] | [344, 122, 81] |
| k3_load, no control | dog bone Outside | [724, 167, 3] | [739, 180, 13] | [739, 180, 13] |
| k3_load, constant | dog bone Outside | [678, 143, 66] | [683, 143, 69] | [683, 143, 69] |
| k4 lifts | disc / dog bone Outside | 13 / 15 | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 |
| k4 crossings | disc / dog bone Outside | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 (test pen) | 3 / 1 (converter) |
| k4 entries | disc / dog bone Outside | 14 / 16 | - | 1 / 1 |

The Inside rows do not change.

Finding (the two PRs together): with the real converter, the Outside paths have feed crossings in the air, one tool radius outside the stock. A stay-down link of #4275 runs along the air line (y -29) to the door of its approach. It crosses the arc lead of the first entry (moves 2 to 11):
- disc: moves 189, 1664 and 1882 cross move 5 at (-38.398, -28.993)
- dog bone: move 33 crosses move 5 at (4.587, -28.866)

The link stage proves a link against the cuts, the links and the planned cuts. It does not read the leads of the entry stage. The test pen of #4275 has no leads, so it read 0. The pin asserts the counts as measured, so a new crossing makes it red. Follow-up: #4300.

The verifier pin (`k6a_plan_emit`) with the approaches in the path: no `RapidInStock`, no `RapidInPart`, no `PlungeIntoStock`, no `Gouge`. Each descent is a plan entry. The verifier reports the crossings as `Crossing` warnings only (disc 3, dog bone 1). The checked area is not changed. The converter refuses no step: an approach is points of a `Hop::Stay` path.

Gates on `143a6ff`:
- `cargo check --tests -p camcraft-motion`: pass
- `cargo check --tests -p camcraft-pathkernel`: pass
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass
- `kernel_emit` unit tests: 7 passed
- motion `kernel_laws`: 31 passed
- pathkernel `laws`: 140 passed
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/side/path-kernel`: 13 steps, 0 failed (with `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`)
- light lane: not run on this head

Writer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/4269#issuecomment-7209988799

Quick pass after the merge-time refresh (coordinator, read only, no build) on head `143a6ffaf`: the PR merges cleanly with `side/path-kernel` (`fd653b035`). The `conflicts` label is removed and the PR is flagged ready again. Class DELTA: the new head waits for a fresh review. The writer record on #4269 is released. The author's checks are green on this head: `cargo check --tests` for motion and pathkernel, clippy on motion, the motion `kernel_laws` suite (31), `kernel_emit` (7), the pathkernel `laws` suite (140), and the quick gate against the side branch (13 steps, the three example catalog suites included). The light lane did not run on this head.

One point for the reviewer to decide. With the real converter, the K4 law "no feed crosses another" does not hold for the material side Outside: 3 crossings on the disc and 1 on the dog bone. Each one is in the air, one tool radius outside the stock: a stay link of PR #4275 runs along the air line and crosses the arc lead of the first entry. The link proof does not read the leads of the entry stage. The refresh did not change kernel code. It replaced the zero check with a table of the measured counts (`CROSSINGS`: 3 and 1 for Outside, 0 for Inside), so a new crossing still fails the test. The fix is issue #4300. Decide if the PR can merge with the pinned counts, or if #4300 must merge first.

The verifier pin, with the approaches in the path, finds no rapid in the stock or the part, no plunge into the stock and no gouge. The checked area did not change.

merge-ready: delta re-review on `143a6ffaf` is clean - trial merge against `origin/side/path-kernel` is clean, motion suites pass locally (kernel_emit 7/7, k3_load 1/1, k4_order_link 1/1 with crossings pinned 3/1 + 0, k6a_plan_emit 1/1), clippy green. The runner refused this PR by design (sub-PR of a side branch; not a verdict). The crossings are pinned as measured; #4300 stays open as a P7 follow-up.
Left for the maintainer: feat PR, toolpath geometry and side-branch base - merges at the next cut,never in the merge sweep. Head 143a6ffafba794b4575b2c263ea919b2b92a0d02.

Effort: max

Merge into `side/path-kernel` (coordinator of NeoTech): class DELTA. The head merges cleanly with the side branch at `533b4220e`. The merge relies on the clean delta review of 2026-11-27T05:41:49Z on head `143a6ffaf` by the review session camcraft-61 (a separate session from the author's workers, same GitHub account), after the review of head `b2b596b66`. That review has no blocking finding; the crossing counts for Outside (3 and 1, in the air) stay pinned, and issue #4300 has the fix. The condition is recorded on #4023: #4300 is closed before the switch-over. The writer record is released, and no reviewer record is active. Maintainer order (question dialog, 2026-11-26): this session merges reviewed sub-PRs of `side/path-kernel`. Nothing merges to `main` here.
